infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Starff uses the camera so you can photograph and upload compliance documents such as your right-to-work, ID and certificates.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Starff needs access to your photos so you can upload existing images of your documents and a profile photo.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Starff uses Face ID to let you sign in quickly and securely after your first login.
